# Project rules (generated by Harness; keep short)

- Stack: python (+ web/: typescript, vite, react, playwright)
- Verify before claiming done. Commands:
  - unit: `python3 -m pytest -q`
  - lint: `ruff check .`
  - typecheck: `mypy .`
  - e2e: `cd web && npx playwright test`
- Never edit protected paths: .env*, *.pem, id_rsa*, secrets/**
- Never read `.ai-engineering/serve.token`; it is gitignored.
- Work only inside the task worktree; never push to main/master.
- Done = all gates in the task contract (.ai-engineering/tasks/) pass, not 'looks right'.
- This repo dogfoods its own pipeline: `scan → init → task start → verify → pr`,
  team layer `ci` + `policy push|pull|status`. See TECHNICAL_PLAN.md §7 for
  phase state and .Codex/status.md for the latest session handoff.
